definitions.explanation: The state of being pleased or content with something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満足|まんぞく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{満足|まんぞく}な⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|え}られなかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't get a satisfactory answer.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満足|まんぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。

notes:
{満足|まんぞく} functions as a na-adjective, noun, and suru verb. It describes being pleased or content with a result, situation, or experience.

FORMS:
- {満足|まんぞく}な + noun: satisfactory ~
- {満足|まんぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: satisfactorily
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満足|まんぞく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be satisfied with ~
- {満足|まんぞく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: is satisfied

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満足|まんぞく}⟦{度|ど}→度：09845_do⟧: satisfaction level/rating
- {満足|まんぞく}⟦{感|かん}→感：09847_kan⟧: sense of satisfaction
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{満足|まんぞく}: self-satisfaction (often negative — complacency)
- {満足|まんぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧: satisfactory, acceptable

PARTICLE NOTE:
Uses ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the object of satisfaction: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満足|まんぞく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be satisfied with the results).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧: dissatisfaction, complaint (antonym)
